# Digits Studio

Brand strategy and launch direction · 22 October 2026

## The name

Use **Digits Studio**, singular, consistently. It is one focused creative practice with room to offer branding, websites and marketing. Do not alternate with “Digits Studios.” Arabic supporting name: **ديجيتس ستوديو**. Keep the Latin wordmark as the main identifier across markets.

The user has approved this name for development. Commercial name clearance remains incomplete. Similar businesses include DIGITS Studio, described as a multimedia business in DR Congo in a [YALI Expo exhibitor listing](https://app.swapcard.com/event/yali-expo/exhibitor/RXhoaWJpdG9yXzIwMjU5MjQ%3D), and [2DIGITS](https://socialbrothers.nl/en/inspiratie/social-brothers-group-lanceert-nieuwe-digitale-productstudio-2digits-agency/). Neither this branding work nor a domain search establishes trademark rights. The user has purchased digitsstudio.online and authorized the public launch. Domain ownership does not establish trademark rights. Do not label the name exclusive, registered or legally cleared.

## Positioning

**A founder-led digital studio in Beirut, helping businesses bring their brand, website and marketing into one clear direction.**

Ahmad Alawieh is the founder and direct point of contact. Position the studio through personal involvement, clear scope and thoughtful execution. Do not imply a large in-house team or a history of agency outcomes that has not been established.

Primary line: **Make your mark.**

Descriptive line: **Branding, websites and marketing. From Beirut, for businesses everywhere.**

Arabic positioning: **استوديو رقمي من بيروت، يساعد الشركات على بناء هوية واضحة وموقع يخدم أعمالها وتسويق يناسب جمهورها.**

Arabic campaign line: **خلّي لعلامتك بصمة.** Use as expressive campaign copy rather than a literal translation of the agency name.

## Who it serves

- Lebanese businesses preparing to launch, refresh their presence or reach customers beyond referrals.
- Founders and small teams who need a clear identity and a professional website without managing disconnected suppliers.
- International businesses that value a direct relationship with the person doing the work.

Lebanese messaging should make Arabic and English communication, WhatsApp contact and local context visible. International messaging should explain the offer, direct founder contact and project process without relying on Lebanese familiarity. Do not promise worldwide legal, localization or media-buying coverage.

## The offer

These are starting scopes for a proposal, not fixed-price packages. Agree deliverables, revisions, timeline, ownership, dependencies and fees in writing for each project.

| Offer | Purpose | Suggested scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Brand foundations | Make the business recognisable and consistent | Discovery, positioning direction, logo system, colour and type, practical brand guide, launch templates |
| Website launch | Give visitors a clear path from interest to inquiry | Page planning, copy direction, responsive design and development, accessible interaction, inquiry setup, basic search metadata and handover |
| Content & marketing | Give the brand a consistent publishing direction | Audience and channel planning, monthly content calendar, reusable social templates, campaign creative and agreed reporting |
| Connected launch | Bring the identity and website together | Brand foundations plus an agreed website scope and launch content set |

Paid advertising budgets, photography, specialist translation, ongoing maintenance and third-party subscriptions must be scoped separately when required. Offer marketing services transparently as a current service; do not invent previous campaign results or specialist certifications.

## Reasons to choose the studio

- Work directly with Ahmad from the initial conversation through delivery.
- Connect the visual identity, website and launch content in one project direction.
- Explain decisions and agree the scope before production.
- Make the next step clear for the business and its customers.

These are operating commitments, not claims of measured revenue or conversion improvement.

## Voice

Plain, confident and approachable. Use short sentences and useful specifics. “Tell me what you're building” is more appropriate than “Unlock your digital potential.” Address a business owner as a person. Explain unfamiliar terms. Use “I” when Ahmad speaks personally; “Digits Studio” when describing the business. Avoid “our global team,” “industry-leading,” guaranteed growth and inflated urgency.

Arabic should sound natural and clear. Use simple standard Arabic for service information and light Lebanese Arabic for campaign lines. Keep phone numbers, email addresses and URLs in left-to-right text. Do not fill Arabic captions with unnecessary English marketing terms.

## Visual direction

The user's yellow-and-dark Digits reference is the starting point. Keep the bold energy while improving recognition at small sizes. The mark must work in one colour and without the yellow panel.

| Token | Hex | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Signal yellow | #FFDA46 | Main recognition colour; major brand fields and deliberate highlights |
| Graphite | #292A32 | Wordmark, body text and strong contrast |
| Paper white | #FFFFFF | Breathing room and long-form surfaces |
| Soft grey | #EEEDF2 | Secondary surfaces and practical layouts |
| Soft lilac | #B4A6ED | Optional supporting campaign colour, used sparingly |

Use graphite text on yellow, white, grey and lilac. Avoid yellow body text on white. Use a distinctive, readable geometric display voice with a quieter text style; use an Arabic companion with compatible proportions. Keep the wordmark large when it is the main image, and let a simple D symbol serve small avatars and icons. Do not turn every letter into a puzzle.

Layout: strong left alignment for English, right alignment for Arabic, generous open space and one clear message per asset. The wordmark carries the personality; secondary typography and framing stay restrained. No fake device dashboards or invented client results.

## Website message hierarchy

1. Digits Studio and a clear statement of branding, websites and marketing.
2. A visible invitation to discuss a project via WhatsApp or email.
3. Services described through the business needs they address.
4. Selected previous website work by Ahmad, accurately attributed.
5. A simple process: discuss, define scope, design and build, review and launch.
6. Founder introduction and direct contact details.

Suggested hero: **A clear brand. A website that works. A plan to reach people.**

Suggested introduction: **Digits Studio brings branding, websites and marketing into one direction. Led by Ahmad Alawieh in Beirut, working with businesses in Lebanon and beyond.**

Primary action: **Discuss your project**. Secondary action: **View selected work**. Use “Message Ahmad” where a direct personal contact label is helpful.
